tasks.description: Documents the tables, columns, types and keys of a SQL schema as Markdown. Use when asked to document a database schema from its DDL files.
tasks.intent: Document tables and columns from the SQL DDL files.

tasks.description: Lists the foreign-key relationships declared in SQL DDL files. Use when asked for the foreign-key relationships of a database schema.
tasks.intent: List foreign-key relationships declared in the SQL schema.

tasks.description: Finds foreign-key columns without a leading index and suggests CREATE INDEX statements. Use when asked for missing-index recommendations for a database schema.
tasks.intent: Recommend indexes for uncovered foreign-key columns.
